en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of the ornate entrance to a historic brick building. The entrance features wide stone steps leading up to an arched doorway, surrounded by decorative sculptures of human figures and faces above and beside the door. Tall, multi-paned windows with shutters and latticework are prominent on either side. The text at the bottom of the image is in Dutch.
